title: Roles and priority decide who changes what; others send change requests
rationale: Decided 2026-10-10. Owner changes anything, including roles and priorities; Engineer changes part details and CAD items; Purchaser changes supplier data and orders; Viewer changes nothing. When two members edit one field, the higher priority wins; on a tie, the app asks. Others send a change request that a higher-priority member accepts or rejects. Replaces users.can_edit_catalog.

title: A team code on the team server names the team's KiCad libraries
rationale: User decision 2026-10-17 (kicad-parts-f397, ADR 0015). One person works for several teams, so libraries are named CODE-Parts and CODE-Resistor_SMD. Boards save footprint library names, so the code belongs to the team: team_settings holds it, and POST /api/team/code sets it once. Folders are kicad-libraries/CODE, tied to the settings record ID.

name: HTTPS to team servers: one ServerTrust for REST and realtime
description: Seed kicad-parts-5ac5. tls.rs builds one rustls config (ring, rustls-platform-verifier) and implements ureq 2's TlsConnector, so ureq needs no tls feature. Realtime wraps its own socket in the same setup. ConnectionProblem in connection.rs maps every failure to one plain message. Tests trust an rcgen authority through the test-trust feature, never the OS store (ADR 0017).
Walking an error chain with source() never found the rustls error inside an io::Error. io::Error::source returns the wrapped error's own source, not the wrapped error.
resolution: Look inside with io::Error::get_ref and downcast_ref, as problem_in_io in crates/collaboration/src/connection.rs does.

title: Stay signed in to every team through the system's password store
rationale: User request 2026-10-18 (kicad-parts-f10d, ADR 0018). One session per team server, side by side. Each team's renewable token, never the password, goes in the OS credential store via keyring, renewed at start and at half its life. A rejected token asks only that team again; with no store, sign-ins last until the app closes. Replaces the in-memory part of mx-b959cf.

name: Several teams: Teams, one TeamCatalog each, a keeper each
description: Seed kicad-parts-f10d, updated by 8a71. teams/mod.rs holds the list; each team has a TeamCatalog (session, follower) and a keeper thread that carries on, keeps and renews its token. Teams::team(server) serves every request about one team; Teams::known_parts feeds the part list; Teams::signed_in serves work across teams. keyring code lives only in apps/desktop; journeys pass --sign-ins=memory.

title: A team's KiCad library folder takes updates only from its recorded server
rationale: kicad-parts-092b, ADR 0015. Any server could claim a team's settings ID, so a folder from another server is not written. The row offers Use the new address only while that server is not in your teams; else it says two servers claim the team. Answers name the server shown. A folder with no server adopts the first claimer.

name: A team's parts reach the part list through one seam
description: Seed kicad-parts-8a71. TeamCatalog::last_known_parts gives KnownParts, cached per (session, checkpoint, imports); none while it must sign in again. The list, the part panel (part_in_list) and the Libraries browser read team parts only there; part_list.rs makes rows once per change. Offline starts (ed46) change only last_known_parts.
